original_test_intent: Physically assess switch-board serviceability and seating, perform one approved plug/unplug cycle, and verify after the required recovery/reboot that the same board/device is detected without new errors.
original_method: A trained operator identifies the exact board and slot, records pre-state and photos, establishes ESD and required power isolation, removes/reseats the board once per the service procedure, restores retention/cables/chassis, performs the approved reboot or reinitialization, and compares post-state device, link/driver and error evidence to baseline.
manual_activity: A trained operator performs and visually judges the physical switch-board inspection, plug/unplug/reseat, retention restoration and approved reboot; the owner reviews the combined physical and system evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/chassis, exact switch-board FRU/serial and slot/connector/retention/cable map
Approved service procedure, permitted cycle count, power-state and ESD requirements
Pre/post detection identity, firmware/driver/link and error acceptance criteria
Independent console, recovery/rollback procedure and spare/service escalation path
Camera/evidence labeling, operator identity and no-log-clear policy
safety_requirements: Only a trained operator may handle the board under the approved ESD and power-safe procedure
Do not manipulate energized hardware unless the service procedure explicitly authorizes it
Stop on wrong identity, bent pin, connector/retention damage, excessive force, unexpected power state, boot failure or new hardware error
Perform one approved cycle only; preserve evidence and diagnose before any repeat
Restore all latches, screws, cables and chassis closure before power/reboot
agent_execution_scope: Verify row-2002 variant identity and prepare evidence checklist
Collect and compare pre/post remote inventory, firmware, driver/link state and logs after operator authorization
Hash and organize operator photos, timeline and command outputs
Flag identity changes, missing detection, link/driver errors or incomplete physical evidence
Perform no physical manipulation, visual seating verdict, reboot authorization or DUT PASS/FAIL decision
engineer_actions: Approve exact board/slot, service procedure, safe state, cycle count and recovery plan
Ensure trained operator completes physical inspection/reseat and signs the evidence
Review pre/post physical and system changes and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The refusal is correct: no remote command can perform or visually verify physical seating and plug force. Remote tools only support pre/post detection and error collection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use project-approved read-only inventory, PCIe/device, driver/link, BMC/host log and firmware commands before and after the operator's single physical cycle; exact commands depend on the switch-board interface and package.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Switch Board scope, plug/unplug and post-cycle detection intent, seating criterion and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL MANUAL PHYSICAL SWITCH-BOARD RESEAT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed physical checklist and before/after photo set keyed to board FRU/serial and slot, with ESD/power confirmation, one-cycle timeline and correlated post-reboot device/link/driver/error evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, safe-state, recovery and evidence controls without automating the essential physical judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Remote detection alone cannot prove seating or connector condition; physical photos/inspection and system detection/error evidence are both mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removal can damage connectors or strand the SUT. A successful boot does not prove correct seating, and a remote session cannot verify force, latch engagement or pin condition.

project_override_considerations: If the board is designed for hot service, the exact energized-handling procedure and isolation boundaries must be explicitly supplied; otherwise default to full approved power isolation. Do not borrow CX8 cable procedures from the row-2005 same-code variant.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus board FRU/serial, slot, connectors, retention/cables and service-procedure revision
Operator identity, ESD/power-safe confirmation and before/after labeled photos
Pre/post inventory, firmware, driver/link state, reboot/recovery timeline and unfiltered BMC/host errors
One-cycle/no-repeat/no-log-clear audit, restored hardware state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets switch-board physical cycling, detection and seating. The shared code creates an identity hazard but row 2002 and its hash unambiguously define this variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is MANUAL ONLY rather than globally blocked. Physical access, trained operator, service procedure and recovery controls are execution prerequisites while static review is complete.

review_improvement: Binds the shared code to the Switch Board row and turns the vague plug-cycle instruction into a one-cycle, identity-controlled, recoverable physical evidence workflow.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mechanical seating and connector condition cannot be inferred from enumeration: a marginal contact can enumerate initially, and a correctly detected device can still have incomplete latch engagement. Conversely, loss of detection after the cycle must be correlated with exact board/slot identity before attribution. Because the code is reused for an unrelated CX8 cable variant, row and hash binding are part of the engineering evidence, not bookkeeping. One controlled cycle protects the hardware and preserves causal evidence.
